items.html: A tall left-handed batsman, Mohammad Naim impressed immediately in his debut season by racking up 556 runs at 46.33 in the 2017-18 50-over Dhaka Premier League. While his first-class and T20 debuts weren't as productive, he returned to form in the 2019 DPL by finishing the tournament with 807 runs at 53.80, with three centuries. This earned him a berth in the Bangladesh A team for the series against Afghanistan A and Sri Lanka A, where he impressed. This paved way for his maiden T20I call-up for the series in India.
